messages:
anya: heads up — CI secret-scan flagged a commit that added a terraform.tfstate.backup with a Vault token embedded. filing here for rotation.

dev-bot: automated alert: secret-detection (high) in repo infra/terraform commit abcdef1. pattern matched: "vault_token". ticket SEC-20240720-01 created.

leo: which workspace/backend? prod or staging?

anya: path: infra/terraform/prod/.terraform/terraform.tfstate.backup. token value redacted but last6 == xyz789. looks like it came from a dev machine and got accidentally committed.

ops: ack. we should assume token is compromised. immediate steps: 1) revoke token/accessor 2) rotate any secrets the token had access to (DB creds, API keys) 3) search for other exposures 4) run vault audit for usage.

dev: that was me — I ran a local `terraform apply` while logged into vault and then committed without cleaning .terraform. sorry everyone.

leo: do we have the accessor? tfstate backup includes token_accessor field usually. can someone paste the accessor id (last 8 chars only)?

anya: accessor present: tknacc-9f8b7c6d (last8: 7c6d). running `vault token revoke-accessor tknacc-9f8b7c6d` now.

anya: output: `Success! Token accessor revoked.`

security-bot: vault-audit: entry found using that token accessor — read operation on kv/data/prod/db-creds at 2024-07-20T03:12:14Z from IP 35.12.45.67. created forensic subtask SEC-20240720-01-FOR.

oncall-sre: if DB creds were read, assume rotation of DB user and any services using it. I'll take service rotation for the ingestion and analytics pools.

ops: starting DB rotation: creating new DB user prod_app_v2 and rotating passwords. will update Vault kv path and push new secrets to sealed-secrets for k8s.

leo: check whether the vault token allowed rewrap/unseal operations. if token could rewrap KMS-encrypted backups we need to rekey KMS DEKs and rewrap snapshots.

security-bot: no unseal or rewrap calls in the audit window. actions were limited to kv read and metadata list. still recommend rewrapping critical backups as a precaution.

maria: legal: please preserve timeline and provide notification guidance. hold off on external disclosure until we know if data was exfiltrated. I'll queue a legal review.

dev: again, sorry. what's the best remediation practice so I don't do this again?

ops: remove .terraform from repo, add .terraform to .gitignore, scrub history (BFG), and rotate all tokens in that commit. also enable commit hooks that block tfstate files and require pre-commit secret-scan.

leo: RBAC follow-up: tighten Vault token issuance policy — avoid long-lived tokens and restrict tokens created on dev machines to dev namespaces only. consider enabling token roles for OIDC login with short TTL.

anya: repo grep queued: scanning for `vault_token|terraform.tfstate|.terraform` across all repos. devex will run and report results.

ops: I've created these tasks:
- SEC-20240720-01: incident triage (owner: anya)
- SEC-20240720-02: db credential rotate & k8s secret update (owner: oncall-sre)
- INFRA-1209: scrub git history + block tfstate commits (owner: ops)
- VAULT-709: token issuance policy tighten + OIDC migration (owner: leo)

security-bot: added retention export for vault audit logs for the last 90 days to forensic bucket, ticket FOR-20240720-01.

oncall-sre: rotated service accounts depending on the DB creds and redeployed affected k8s deployments. monitoring for failed auths for next 30m.

anya: revoked token, rotated DB creds, patched sealed-secrets, removed tfstate backup from PR, and opened BFG scrub PR. incident remains open for postmortem and legal.

maria: legal has requested the commit diff and the timeline of token usage; I attached SEC-20240720-01 to the legal queue.

leo: postmortem items: 1) enforce pre-commit secret scanning and block commits with tfstate 2) migrate to short-lived OIDC tokens for devs 3) update runbooks for token exposure 4) schedule Vault key rotation/rewrap drill.

anya: thanks everyone — immediate rotation work complete. leaving incident open for retrospective and policy changes. :lock:
